treaty_name: Convention between the Government of the Kingdom of Sweden and the Government of the Republic of Azerbaijan for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income (2016)
source_title: Lag (2016:928) om skatteavtal mellan Sverige och Azerbajdzjan (SFS 2016:928, Swedish and English texts)

rates.quote: (b) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 8 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.
(b) 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties in all other cases.

ppt.quote: Pursuant to Article 35(7)(a) of the Convention, the Kingdom of Sweden reserves the right to replace: i) the references in Article 35(1) and (4) to "the latest of the dates on which this Convention enters into force for each of the Contracting Jurisdictions to the Covered Tax Agreement"; ...

notes: Dividend 5% tier additionally requires the participation to exceed EUR 200,000 (Swedish text: invested more than EUR 200 000). Royalties: 5% cap for patents, trade marks, designs/models, plans, secret formulas/processes and know-how (Art. 12(2)(a)); 10% for all other royalties (incl. copyright) - only the 10% general tier modelled. Interest exempt at source (Art. 11(3)) for government/central bank/statutory bodies, government-approved loans, and loans granted/guaranteed by SIDA, SEK, Swedfund, EKN, State Oil Fund of Azerbaijan or other public export/development institutions. Treaty in force 2016-12-22; Art. 28(2)(a): WHT effect from 1 January of the year following entry into force => 2017-01-01. MLI: both covered, but Sweden made an Art. 35(7)(a) reservation and the OECD signatories list (status 15 Sep 2026) shows no Art. 35(7)(b) notification for Sweden, so MLI (incl. PPT) not yet effective for this treaty. AZ reserved MLI Art. 8 entirely (no 365-day holding). [curated: dropped DIVIDEND tier — reduced rate also needs a minimum invested amount — not modelled]
